method_notes: Metricool is the source of truth for numeric post metrics.
Post wording and visual format were recovered from each public Instagram URL using accessibility alt text and direct visual inspection.
Seven posts that Instagram did not transcribe were read directly from the rendered post image.
Seven phrases unavailable through Instagram accessibility data were matched from the user-supplied audit; these are marked medium confidence.
The September 12 breakout phrase was also corroborated by a visible post comment.
